title: THE WORLD'S
10 MOST POPULOUS
COUNTRIES

hook.say: The ten most populous countries on Earth, ranked. Two of them hold a third of humanity!

outro.say: Is your country on the list? Comment below!

outroLines: IS YOUR COUNTRY ON THE LIST?

items.name: Ethiopia
items.say: Number ten: Ethiopia, the fastest growing on this list. 139 million.

items.name: Bangladesh

items.name: Pakistan

items.name: Indonesia

items.name: India
items.say: And number one: India! One-point-four-eight billion people, more than one in six humans.
